C0479.title: Sichuan Mianyang Police Dismantle Cross-Province Mobile Points Redemption Fraud Ring
C0479.summary: In March 2020, suspect Zhang Mouyun and others built a telecom fraud network spanning Sichuan, Fujian, and Hebei provinces, illegally obtaining users' mobile points and redeeming them for profit. In July 2021, Mianyang police successfully dismantled the ring, involving electronic points worth tens of millions of yuan.

references.title: Fraud company steals millions in electronic points in three months, Sichuan Mianyang police 'wipe out' cross-province gang...
